prompt: Which two MLB teams played in the World Series just weeks after the O.J. Simpson murder trial had ended?
answer: The **Atlanta Braves and Cleveland Indians** (now the Cleveland Guardians) played in the 1995 World Series, which began about two weeks after O.J. Simpson was acquitted on October 3, 1995.
